title: Create executable contract
purpose: Run the model-facing CREATE dialogue that turns the current user prompt into a model-authored executable Python contract using mandatory context injection, deterministic execution-KB retrieval, semantic topic selection, and a fixed terminal dialogue product.

semantics: Ask the model for the exact current user prompt.
Inject the mandatory prompt-to-goal KB entry and request a goal.
Inject the mandatory goal-to-query KB entry and request execution-KB queries.
Run the queries deterministically and expose compact selectable KB topic projections plus the mandatory topic-selection KB entry.
Resolve the model-selected topic IDs to their full canonical KB records.
Inject the full selected KB records plus the mandatory execution-script construction KB entry.
Request the executable Python contract and the next lifecycle choice: execute, revise, or exit.
Exit successfully without another stdout message so the transaction wrapper can use the last model stdin object as the dialogue product.

execution_script.description: Complete Python source for the execution phase. On successful completion it must write exactly one JSON value to stdout.

return_schema.description: JSON Schema for the execution script's one successful stdout JSON value. The root execution result type must be object.
